story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Existing date sources remain identifiable and selectable for Facets transaction effective date
gaps: TC_001 Description "Verify an AR PASSE inbound 834 enrollment file containing an Eligibility Date in Loop 2000 DTP*356 or DTP*348 is parsed successfully, archived correctly, visible in TM, and loaded so the date is available for population as the Facets transaction effective date without breaking current processing." is the closest related case, but the scenario acceptanceCriteriaRef also requires "EDI is able to identify the following dates in the EDI 834 file (existing functionality): Effective Date, Assessment Date, Maintenance Date."; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date when eligibility span has not yet begun
gaps: Coverage completeness: scenario description requires "Conditions to cover: 1) Eligibility span has not yet begun and Assessment Date is earlier than Eligibility Date, but Eligibility Date is used." but the table contains only one test case id "TC_001"; add dedicated test cases for the remaining required scenario output count of 6.
Only one unique Test Case Id appears in the table: "TC_001" in field "Test Case Id" across all rows, while the scenario was to produce 6 test cases.

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Assessment Date
gaps: Coverage completeness: scenario description requires "Conditions to cover: 1) Eligibility span has already begun and Assessment Date changes." but the table contains only one test case id "TC_001" while "{"passscore": 95, "stepsmin": 7, "stepsmax": 18, "testcasesperscenario": 6}" indicates multiple test cases were to be produced; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with unchanged relevant fields preserves field values and uses Assessment Date

flagged.why: missing test cases for listed scenario count

gaps: Coverage completeness gap for scenario TS_004: scenario description lists only one condition, "1) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged.", but the generator was told to produce 6 test cases and the table provides only "TC_001". Add dedicated additional test cases or distinct variants if multiple cases are required for this scenario.

scenarios.title: Future eligibility relevant-field changes with unchanged Assessment Date use Eligibility Date
gaps: Duplicate intent with Test Case Id field "TC_002": both validate unchanged Assessment Date with future eligibility using Eligibility Date as transaction effective date; TC_001 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Assessment Number change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date" and TC_002 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Assessment Tier change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date"

Duplicate intent with Test Case Id field "TC_003": both validate unchanged Assessment Date with future eligibility using Eligibility Date as transaction effective date; TC_002 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Assessment Tier change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date" and TC_003 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Assessment Division change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date"

Duplicate intent with Test Case Id field "TC_004": both validate unchanged Assessment Date with future eligibility using Eligibility Date as transaction effective date; TC_003 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Assessment Division change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date" and TC_004 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Aid Category change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date"

Duplicate intent with Test Case Id field "TC_005": both validate unchanged Assessment Date with future eligibility using Eligibility Date as transaction effective date; TC_004 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Aid Category change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date" and TC_005 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Rate Cell change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date"

Duplicate intent with Test Case Id field "TC_006": both validate unchanged Assessment Date with future eligibility using Eligibility Date as transaction effective date; TC_005 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Rate Cell change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date" and TC_006 field "Test Case Name" = "Verify AR PASSE future eligibility Pregnancy change uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date"

scenarios.title: Current eligibility relevant-field changes with unchanged Assessment Date use Maintenance Date only in the allowed case
gaps: Semantic duplicate with "TC_002": both validate the same business intent of using Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date for a relevant-field change after eligibility has begun with unchanged Assessment Date; shared intent shown by TC_001 Test Case Name "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 uses Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date when Assessment Number changes after Eligibility Date and Assessment Date is unchanged" and TC_002 Test Case Name "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 uses Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date when Assessment Tier changes after Eligibility Date and Assessment Date is unchanged".
